title_en: Chinese Humor (4/20): The Birth of "Barbell Bro"
note_en: A gym newbie puts on a whole circus act, from a catapulting barbell to hanging in mid-air off an exercise ball, and the internet nicknames him "Barbell Bro." Then come more funny gym stories: a grandpa in slippers who outdoes bodybuilders on the pull-up bar, a midnight trip to a 24-hour gym for milk tea, earphones that blast a love song across the gym, and a machine used back to front.
